subject: Credentials & Training Artifact hand-off for SOC2/SIG review
messages:
From: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@brightline-sec.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: audit@brightline-sec.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Compact personnel credentialing snapshot + sample redactions (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Stephanie / Grace,

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. As part of Brightline's SOC 2 scoping for Redwood, the evidence team needs a compact package showing: background-check completion rates for active employees, a short export of security awareness training completion for the last 12 months, and a small sample of redacted background-checks to validate PII handling.

Can you provide a single ZIP (or Drive folder) with: 
- a CSV of personnel attestations and hire/exit timestamps for the period 2024-2026;
- training completion export with course IDs and completion timestamps;
- 3 redacted background-check PDFs (employee names replaced, vendor stamps retained);
- the onboarding and deprovisioning runbook excerpt used by IT/Security.

Ideal timeline: by EOD Monday, Dec 7. If there are sensitivity constraints, please flag them and we can accept redacted samples and a written attestation for the remainder.

Oliver
Oliver Chen
Senior Auditor, Brightline Security
oliver.chen@brightline-sec.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@brightline-sec.com>, audit@brightline-sec.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Compact personnel credentialing snapshot + sample redactions (SOC2/SIG)

Thanks Oliver — we can do that. Quick notes on scope and delivery: 

- We will provide the CSV attestation export and training sheet. The BG-check vendor restricts full copies, so we'll include 3 vendor-redacted samples plus a short attestation from HR describing the redaction process.
- Onboarding/deprovisioning runbook: we'll export the relevant markdown excerpt and include the audit trail for recent offboards (last 12 months).
- Delivery method: secure Drive folder + a DocuSign attestation if you need formal signing.

Logistics (who's on it): Grace will pull the training export; Karthik will handle the personnel attestation CSV and the offboard audit log; Monica will coordinate the vendor redactions and assemble the sample PDFs.

I'll aim to drop the package in the Drive link and ping you when ready. If Monday end-of-day is tight for any of you, we can extend to Wednesday.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0193

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@brightline-sec.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Compact personnel credentialing snapshot + sample redactions (SOC2/SIG)

Oliver — putting the first pass together now. ETA for folder: today by 4pm PST. Contents preview below (we'll upload as separate files, plus a single index README):

- personnel_attestation_Q4_2026.csv (fields: employee_id, hire_date, termination_date, role, security_clearance, attestation_signed_at)
- training_export_2026-11.xlsx (fields: employee_id, course_id, course_name, completion_date, score)
- bgcheck_redacted_sample.pdf (3 files: sample_A, sample_B, sample_C)
- onboard-deprovisioning-runbook.md (extracted sections: account creation, access approvals, deprovision checklist, audit logging)
- README_evidence_index.md (explains redaction methodology and links to vendor attestation)

Attachments (stubs):
- personnel_attestation_Q4_2026.csv (CSV)
- training_export_2026-11.xlsx (XLSX)
- bgcheck_redacted_sample.pdf (PDF x3)
- onboard-deprovisioning-runbook.md (MD)

We will redact employee names and SSNs in the BG samples; vendor stamps and verification sections will be preserved. Karthik — I included the SEC-924 Jira link in the README per your request. Monica — please make sure the vendor's written attestation (redaction policy) is attached.

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Manager, IT Compliance | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com

From: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@brightline-sec.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: audit@brightline-sec.com, Priya Rao <prao@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 15:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Compact personnel credentialing snapshot + sample redactions (SOC2/SIG)

Grace / Stephanie — this is perfect, thanks. We'll download the folder and validate the sample redactions and the attestation. If everything looks good we'll mark this item resolved for the SOC 2 interim and reference the README in our evidence binder.

Two quick asks after review: 
1) Can you include an index row in the CSV showing the total headcount and number of active employees at quarter-close?
2) Please attach the vendor attestation as a signed DocuSign (if possible) so our compliance team can track signature timestamps.

If you can drop those two items into the same Drive folder, we're set. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Oliver
Senior Auditor, Brightline Security
